name: pcbway
label: PCBWay
notes: Checked against pcbway.com/capabilities.html on 2026-11-09: minimum track/space 0.1 mm (4 mil), minimum CNC drill 0.15 mm, maximum drill 6.0 mm, minimum annular ring 0.15 mm, silkscreen characters 0.8 mm high / 0.15 mm line, hole-to-hole 16 mil for component holes, track to milled board edge 0.25 mm. PCBWay's KiCad guide asks for Protel extensions, X2 off, one zip; its assembly help accepts a KiCad .pos file as the centroid file (mm). 'standard' rules are deliberately looser than the minimums. UNVERIFIED: that 0.15 mm (6 mil) track/space and 0.3 mm via drill are the no-surcharge defaults of the quote form; the 0.2 mm via drill / 0.5 mm via diameter used for 'advanced'; hole_clearance; npth_min; the BOM column headers (modelled on PCBWay's sample BOM: Item #, Designator, Qty, Manufacturer, Mfg Part #, Description / Value, Package/Footprint, Type); whether PCBWay prefers one merged drill file. Unsourced parts do not block the export because PCBWay sources by MPN or by description; they are listed in the result instead. No assembly rotation table: PCBWay's engineers review orientation against the silkscreen.

advanced.label: PCBWay tight (4 mil, 0.2 mm vias, may cost extra)

order_notes: Order: upload the zip at pcbway.com (PCB Instant Quote); for assembly add the BOM and the centroid file and confirm part orientation with PCBWay's engineer before production
